name: Exhibition of the Heart
source:
Alice is a lonely university student who never got over her first crush, the upright and studious Sylvia. Until one day, she discovers that Sylvia is actually a shameless exhibitionist! Can the timid Alice win her heart? Find out in this cute nsfw yuri visual novel!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4724580/]Steam[/url]]

爱丽丝是一个孤独的大学生，她一直无法忘记她的初恋——正直好学的西尔维娅。直到有一天，她发现西尔维娅竟然是一个无耻的暴露狂！胆小的爱丽丝能否赢得她的芳心呢？在这部可爱的NSFW尤里视觉小说中找到答案！
